about.journey1: I graduated in Information Technology from Ho Chi Minh City Open University in 2023, where I built a strong foundation in programming and software development.
about.journey2: Currently, I focus on Front-End development with <bold>React</bold> and <bold>Next.js</bold>, while expanding into Backend using <bold>Django REST Framework</bold>. Over the past year, I have worked on personal and freelance projects, sharpening my skills in building real-world applications and delivering smooth user experiences.
about.journey3: Looking ahead, I aim to grow into a Fullstack Developer, continuously improving my expertise and contributing to impactful, scalable web solutions.
